topics.label: Introduction to the lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic and sets expectations regarding complement complexity.

topics.label: Foundations and central mechanism of the complement cascade
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the overarching principles, nomenclature conventions, and central role of C3 in complement activation.

topics.label: Complement activation pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the three distinct recognition pathways that activate complement and converge on the C3 trigger threshold.

topics.label: Effector mechanisms of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the downstream effector processes through which activated complement eliminates pathogens and drives inflammation.

topics.label: Host cell regulation of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains how host cells express regulatory proteins to prevent unintended complement-mediated damage.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the distinct disease presentations and clinical impacts associated with deficiencies in various complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion mechanisms and biomedical applications
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores how pathogens evade complement attack and how these evasion factors are utilised in medicine and research.

topics.label: Conclusion and preview of next lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture on complement and provides a brief forward look to the next topic.
